list.title: Search Catalog
list.description: Stored, validated AQL searches. Only persisted definitions are scheduled or executed — the frontend never runs ad-hoc AQL.
list.emptyWriter: Use New search to store a disabled definition, then run the stored query before enabling it.
list.emptyReader: Creating a search needs search:write. An admin or the detection_engineer role can grant it.
list.name: Name

detail.title: Search detail
detail.loadFailedHelp: It may have been removed, or the backend may be unreachable. Reload the page to try again.
detail.noExecutions: No executions yet. The first appears after this search runs on its schedule or is run now.

new.title: New search
new.description: A new search is saved disabled. Run it from its page to preview the result; only the saved query ever runs.

executions.label: Execution history
executions.caption: Executions of this search, newest first, with status, result count and threshold verdict. Times are UTC.
executions.lowerBoundNote: Truncated: the search stopped at its row cap, so this count is a lower bound
executions.noVerdictNote: No verdict: the count is a lower bound, so the threshold cannot be judged
executions.noteBound: “≥” marks a truncated run: the search stopped at its row cap, so the count is a lower bound.
executions.noteVerdict: “No verdict” means a truncated run did not breach its threshold at the count it reached; the real count may still be above it. A run measured within its threshold shows “—”.

schedule.saved: Saved. The next run follows the new schedule.
schedule.forbidden: Your role cannot change this schedule (permission search:write).

enable.capped: Not enabled: {limit}. Disable another search, then enable this one.

run.forbidden: Your role cannot run a stored search (permission search:execute).
run.gone: This search no longer exists. Reload the page.
run.failed: The run did not start. Reload the page and try again.

notice.hiddenUnknown: Your permissions could not be read, so the editor stays hidden.
notice.needs: Changing a stored search needs search:write. An admin or the detection_engineer role can grant it. Stored searches stay readable.

editor.latency: This search runs in QRadar on its schedule; its result and any threshold breach appear after each run completes, not in real time. For alerting within seconds, use QRadar's own rules.
editor.name: Name
editor.customCron: Custom cron is kept as stored.
editor.thresholdHint: Leave the value empty when this search has no threshold.
editor.storedAs: Stored as {stored}. Pie and heatmap are not offered for a new search. Leave this value, or choose table, line, bar, or single value.
editor.changeNoteHint: Recorded when the query text changes and a new version is stored.
editor.savedSame: Saved. The query text is unchanged, so the version stayed the same.
editor.savedNew: Saved as v{version}. Run now executes this stored version.

validation.whole: Enter a whole number of {unit}, from {min} to {max}.
validation.nameLength: Name must be 255 characters or fewer.
validation.descriptionLength: Description must be 2,000 characters or fewer.
validation.noteLength: The change note must be 1,000 characters or fewer.
validation.threshold: Threshold must be a number, or empty when the search has no threshold.

refusal.network: The search could not be saved. Check the connection and try again.
refusal.forbidden: Your role cannot change stored searches (permission search:write). An admin or the detection_engineer role can grant it. Nothing was saved.
refusal.gone: This search no longer exists. Reload the page.
refusal.server: The server could not save the search. Try again shortly.
